data.use_energy_dashboard: Use solar forecast from the Energy dashboard

data_description.price_entity: A sensor whose attributes hold the hourly or quarter-hourly prices for today and tomorrow (Tibber, Frank Energie, Zonneplan, Nordpool, ENTSO-e).
data_description.price_multiplier: Leave at 1 unless the prices are not in EUR/kWh, ct/kWh or EUR/MWh.
data_description.solar_entity: Only needed when the Energy dashboard has no forecast, e.g. a Solcast sensor with a detailed forecast attribute.
data_description.base_load_w: Solar production above this level counts as surplus.
data_description.export_deduction: How much less a returned kWh yields than a purchased kWh costs. At 0, solar power does not influence the advice.
data_description.ai_entity: An AI Task or conversation entity (e.g. Ollama) that rewrites the daily advice. The calculations do not depend on it.

data_description.power_entity: Live power in W or kW, e.g. from a smart plug.
data_description.start_w: Above this power a cycle starts.
data_description.stop_w: Below this power the cycle may be finished.
data_description.stop_delay_min: How long the power must stay below the stop threshold. Make it longer than the longest pause within a programme.
data_description.tolerance_pct: Higher recognises programmes more easily but confuses similar ones sooner.
data_description.window_start: Advice only proposes start times you can actually use.
data_description.dryer_entry: Washing machine only: the dryer that runs after each wash. Add the dryer first.

data_description.outdoor_entity: A temperature sensor or a weather entity. With a weather entity the hourly forecast is used.
data_description.airco_entities: Energy (kWh) or power (W) sensors of the air conditioners.
data_description.cop_7: Assumption from the unit's datasheet; it cannot be measured without a heat meter.

error.stop_above_start: The stop threshold must not exceed the start threshold.

label_cycle.name: Label cycle
label_cycle.description: Link a cycle to a new or existing programme.

cycle_id.name: Cycle
cycle_id.description: Cycle id; empty means the last cycle.

rename_program.name: Rename programme
rename_program.description: Give a learned programme another name.

delete_program.name: Delete programme
delete_program.description: Remove a learned programme; its cycles become unknown again.

delete_cycle.name: Delete cycle
delete_cycle.description: Remove a cycle, for example when the same run was detected twice. Importing history does not bring it back.

split_cycle.name: Split cycle
split_cycle.description: Split a cycle in two, for example when two runs were counted as one.

cycle_id.name: Cycle
cycle_id.description: Cycle id; empty means the last cycle.

minutes.name: Split after
minutes.description: Minutes after the start of the cycle; empty splits at the quietest period.

import_history.name: Import history
import_history.description: Read earlier cycles or heating days from the recorder.
